scope: Declared artifact type validation, manifest idempotency and browser upload queue/retry behavior
implementation: Declared DICOM/JSON type is authoritative; content mismatch is rejected with ARTIFACT_TYPE_MISMATCH.
Artifact provenance keeps file validity separate from later workflow readiness; manifest roles and checksums remain explicit.

QA Archive accepts multiple files into a per-case queue, captures artifact type and logical role at enqueue time, uploads sequentially, preserves successful items, and exposes retry for failed items only.
Each download action requests a fresh API download response, so an expired signed URL is not reused by the UI action.
